_comment: Per-terrain replacements for broken pydcs Terrain.bounds, in DCS Cartesian metres (x = north/south, y = east/west). Keys match Terrain.name. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

Falklands.source: Estimate: pydcs copies TheChannel's bounds verbatim. Replaced with the extent of the 26 pydcs airfields plus ~50 km margin.

MarianaIslands.source: Estimate: pydcs top bound is 10,000,000 m (typo). Replaced with the extent of the 8 pydcs airfields plus ~50 km margin.
